تستعمرون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْمِرُونَ (tastaʕmirūna) /tas.taʕ.mi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
# تُسْتَعْمَرُونَ (tustaʕmarūna) /tus.taʕ.ma.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
